_note: Compositional contrastive model (internal comparison against the SupCon-off control, Run 4's CE + held-out pairs model, 70.7 / 70.9). Same ConvNeXt-Base backbone, input, augmentation, two-view batches, optimiser settings, validation protocol and final-fit schedule. Changed: the classifier heads, SupCon and the pair-level cross-entropy are replaced by one image-to-pair contrastive (InfoNCE-style) loss. The image embedding is matched to the embedding of every (crop, disease) pair, p(c,d) = normalise(e_c + e_d + MLP([e_c; e_d])), so the pair score models crop and disease together instead of log P(crop) + log P(disease) as independent; unseen pairs use the same composer. Held-out pairs as in Run 4: each step a random 10% of the training pairs are pretend-unseen and all other pairs' scores are shifted down by gamma0 = 6.75 before the cross-entropy over the training pairs (label smoothing 0.1). Rationale from the error analysis: the independence assumption causes lookalike and partial-match errors, SupCon's disease space stayed tied to the crop (9% disease retrieval on unseen images), and a pair-level target removes the dependence on batch composition.
_result: Internal comparison (not for the report). Test HM Top-1 65.33 / Top-5 88.33; seen 57.00, unseen 76.52 (calibrated); 27.2% of seen images sent to unseen pairs. Epoch 5, gamma 7.25, validation HM 57.16 (per split 57.24 / 55.43 / 58.81). Versus the SupCon-off control (CE + held-out pairs, 70.71 / 93.16, validation 61.73) it is 5.4 points lower on test and 4.6 lower on validation, with lower seen-only accuracy (69.2 against 73.2) and much lower unseen-only accuracy (80.2 against 89.1). Validation peaked at epoch 4 to 5 and then fell (split 1: 54.5 at epoch 4, 49.6 at epoch 20), i.e. the model overfits the seen pairs quickly. One untuned configuration. Reading: a joint pair embedding built by a small composer does not beat independent heads on this data.

model._note: ConvNeXt-Base backbone as in the baseline; emb_dim is the shared embedding size, hidden the composer MLP width; init_scale is the starting temperature scale (1/0.07).

input._note: Bicubic resizing, as ConvNeXt was pretrained.

augmentation._note: Same as the independent ConvNeXt-Base baseline.

loss._note: pair_loss: cross-entropy over the training pairs' scores with holdout_frac of them pretend-unseen and the rest shifted by gamma0.

scoring._note: CHANGED: mode heads, the cross-entropy heads' log-probabilities. temperature is only used for the prototypes saved alongside.

optimizer._note: As the independent ConvNeXt-Base baseline (lr_head also covers the projection and cross-entropy heads).

training._note: final_schedule match_validation as in Run 2. No saved validation grid is reused: stage 1 runs in full because the training loss changed.

runtime._note: grad_checkpointing: recompute backbone activations in the backward pass; identical gradients, less GPU memory, somewhat slower. Needed because ConvNeXt-Base with 128 views per step did not fit in 16 GB.
